newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht firm late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht firm late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate stayed steady in a 12.75-13.00 percent range on Thursday as the market took time out to wait for the outcome of a no- confidence debate against Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa.
They said major Thai banks resisted market expectation to ease offered rates while they could get still better returns from lending to finance firms.

"A decision by Banharn to call snap elections would boost sentiment in both stock and money markets. His resignation would satisfy people but to a lesser degree while a cabinet reshuffle would leave investors disappointed," a bank dealer said.
The 391-seat elected Thai lower house will cast its no- confidence vote either on Friday or Saturday.
The baht firmed further to 25.361-25.364 to the dollar in late Thursday trade from 25.365-25.368 in the morning and 25.390-25.395 near the Wednesday close.
"We saw some dollar buying in the afternoon to cover earlier sales in the morning. The no-confidence debate will have some impact on the market when the vote is cast," he said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was unmoved from the morning at 9.50-10.00 satangs per dollar.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the baht/dollar midrate at 25.36 against 25.39 on Wednesday.
